Method of Attack: Linux ELF64 encryptor targeting VMware ESXi servers
Uses 'esxi_utils' library to execute esxcli commands to list VMs, stop firewall, stop VMs before encrypting
Encrypts files matching specific extensions after shutting down VMs
Attack Vector: Targeting VMware ESXi virtual machine platform via Linux encryptor
Indicators of Compromise: Linux ELF64 encryptor sample found on VirusTotal
